descriptions.w3d_d18e_reset_flagged_transform_8024f6f: Adds the Flags link descriptor (0x801ebf38), looks up the Position, Size and Orientation vector properties (binding helper 0x801f0210), sets each three-float value at +8 to the constant at 0x803c56c4 (0.0f), calls the refresh routine 0x801e8d9c and returns 0.
descriptions.w3d_d18e_reset_typed_transform_8024f990: Looks up the Position, Size and Orientation vector properties (binding helper 0x801f0210), sets each three-float value at +8 to the constant at 0x803c5768 (0.0f), registers the Type property (0x801eb834), calls the refresh routine 0x801e8d9c and returns 0.
